name: BuzzGrid
author: Buzzgrid

sections.description:
BuzzGrid allows you to easily connect your WordPress site with the BuzzGrid AI Assistant. Enhance customer interaction and lead generation by integrating an AI-powered chatbot tailored for health and fitness businesses.

Features:

  • Easy Integration: Connect your site with BuzzGrid in just a few clicks.
  • AI Chatbot: Engage visitors with an AI-powered chatbot tailored for health and fitness.
  • Lead Generation: Capture leads directly from conversations.
  • Customer Interaction: Improve customer satisfaction with instant responses.
  • Customizable Settings: Manage your AI Assistant directly from your BuzzGrid dashboard.

Why BuzzGrid?

The future of health and fitness businesses is here. With BuzzGrid, you can provide personalized experiences to your customers, increase engagement, and drive conversions through intelligent AI interactions.

Support

For support and inquiries, please visit https://buzzgrid.com/support or contact us at support@buzzgrid.com.

License

sections.installation:
1. Activate the Plugin
  • Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  1. Connect to BuzzGrid
  • Navigate to the BuzzGrid menu item in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Click on the Connect button to initiate the connection process.
  • You will be redirected to the BuzzGrid accounts page to authenticate and link your site.
  • After successful connection, you can manage your AI Assistant settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BuzzGrid account to use this plugin?

Yes, a BuzzGrid account is required to connect and manage your AI Assistant.

How do I manage my AI Assistant settings?

After connecting, you can manage your AI Assistant by clicking on Manage your AI Assistant in the plugin settings or by logging into your BuzzGrid dashboard.

Is my data secure with BuzzGrid?

Yes, we prioritize the security and privacy of your data. Please review our privacy policy on our website for more details.
